name: Offline Captions (Whisper)
description: Speech → text for your whole computer, running entirely on your device. A Provider app: put it in your Providers folder, assign it to Speech → text in Settings → AI models, and every app that listens — the meeting's captions first — is answered here. It is OpenAI's Whisper: it hears 99 languages and picks the one being spoken, writes real sentences with punctuation, takes a list of your own names and product words, and can write everything down in English whatever language was spoken. Two sizes arrive on first use as hash-pinned downloads: tiny (41 MB, the default on phones) and base (77 MB, the default on computers). It runs on the processor, so a sentence takes a few seconds to appear — longer on a phone.
